review_notes: I read the whole file and grepped Mathlib for uses of the generated simp lemmas. The only external use of `ofComposableArrows` is in MorphismProperty/TransfiniteComposition.lean, which uses the definition and none of its generated simp lemmas. I found no uses of the `_iic`, `_ici`, `_ofOrderIso`, `_map` or `_ofArrowIso` simp lemmas either. The file's simp interface looks reasonable. `fac` is `simp` with `reassoc`, and it rewrites `isoBot.inv ≫ incl.app ⊥` to `f`, which is a clear direction. `initialize_simps_projections (-isColimit)` correctly keeps the colimit proof out of the generated lemmas. The `@[simps]` definitions generate projection lemmas of the usual kind. One uncertainty remains. I could not run Lean, so I could not see the exact form of the generated `incl` lemma for `ofComposableArrows`, where `incl := _` is filled in by unification. I could not show a concrete problem there, so I report nothing.
